yourNature_desc: You are what the blade would be if it never went home to the wall between wars. There is more Metal in you than you use, so a false note pulls at you until you fix it. You would sooner correct a small mistake than let a pleasant evening go on. In the end you pay for that in rest, because you are never fully off guard.

self_card.face: Steel kept out and never hung up
self_card.presence: There is always more in you than the day asks for. You stay ready long after the moment is over, and your calm is what it costs.

_trace.yourNature_desc: surplus Metal turns every false note into a pull to correct it, which costs rest
_trace.presence: readiness outlasting the moment costs calm
